info.longBusinessSummary: HEG Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of graphite electrodes and ancillary products. It operates integrated Graphite Electrode plants that process sophisticated UHP (Ultra High Power) Electrodes. HEG Limited was formerly known as HEG Graphite Limited and change its name to HEG Limited in October 2026. The company was founded in 1977 and is based in Noida, India. HEG Limited operates as a subsidiary of HEG Advanced Materials Limited.
